| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `chance(int target)` | Checks if the given target is less than or equal to a random value between 0 (inclusive) and 100 (exclusive) |
| `chance(int target, int overall)` | Checks if the given target is less than or equal to a random value between 0 (inclusive) and overall (exclusive) |
| `distance(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2)` | Calculates the distance between two sets of coordinates |
| `distance(Point p1, Point p2)` | Calculates the distance between two points |
| `distance(Tile t1, Tile t2)` | Calculates the distance between two tiles. |
| `elapsed(long prevTime)` | Calculates the time elapsed from the supplied previous time. |
| `isBefore(long futureTime)` | Returns true if System time is less than input |
| `nextGammaRandom(int shape, int scale)` | Generates a random value from the GammaDistribution |
| `nextGaussianRandom(double mean, double sigma)` | Generates a random value from the Normal (or Gaussian) distribution with specified mean and standard deviation. |
| `nextHypergeometricRandom(int populationSize, int numberOfSuccesses, int sampleSize)` | Generates a random value from the HypergeometricDistribution . |
| `nextLogNormalDistributionRandom(double scale, double shape)` | Generates a lognormal distribution using the provided parameters with an inverse absolute accuracy of 1e-9 and uses a Well19937c number generator to return a sample |
| `random(double lower, double upper)` | Generates a uniformly distributed random value from the open interval (lower, upper) (i.e., endpoints excluded). |
| `random(int high)` | Returns a number between 0 (inclusive) and high (exclusive) |
| `random(int min, int max)` | Gets a random number between min (inclusive) and max (exclusive) |
| `random(long min, long max)` | Gets a random number between min (inclusive) and max (exclusive) |
